name: Facet
text: Build the Excava interface in Figma as a clickable prototype. It lets users *feel* the flow before code exists, exposing UX gaps faster than static mocks. Trade-off: Figma adds a design step, but the speed of iteration beats polishing the wrong thing.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Figma’s polished demo still risks users mistaking the prototype for the real thing—confusing "feels fast" with "is fast." A better alternative: build a minimal, live-coded HTML/CSS demo that users can *break* in real time, proving speed without the Figma illusion. Settle it with a side-by-side test: measure how many users assume the prototype equals the final product.
